resolution: User reported the column-3 'faces · vertex loops' panel always shows the full per-face topology — an insane wall of text — and tied it to UI vanishing as the model grows. Root cause: ShapePanel.tsx rendered a Row per face (each 2-4 Text children) always-on with no toggle or cap, so a dense solidified mesh (hundreds of faces) piled hundreds/thousands of children + glyphs permanently into the layout, flooding the per-container MAX_CHILDREN=512 cap (a fixed stack array that silently drops overflow) and the glyph load. Fix (sha 7df18f5a5): made the loops list collapsed by DEFAULT behind a show/hide toggle mirroring the existing JSON block, header now shows the face count 'faces · vertex loops (N)', and when expanded it caps at LOOP_ROW_CAP=256 rows with a '…and N more — use copy / show json' footer so it can never spill past the cap again. Full topology remains available via the copy button and show-json. Hot-reloads in the dev host; not yet visually confirmed by the user.
